messages.subject: Manual in Repo?
parts: Someone checked in the pdf of the manual -- before it was up to the user to compile it locally.  Just checking to see if this was intentional or not.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Manual in Repo?
parts:
Yes, that was intentional. It should also have
been added to .gitignore.

The reason it and the Doxygen html docs are there
is so that we can use the pre-packaged release
mechanism of GitHub rather than having to roll our
own tarball.

- Bob
